question: Can a compact spatial basis learned to preserve transition-predictive directions, rather than high state variance, recover the Phase-17 four-family transfer result?

learned_spatial_basis.source: raw physical wave+Gray training trajectories only
learned_spatial_basis.target: next-step minus current-step 3x3 patches from both output channels
learned_spatial_basis.method: per input channel generalized predictive eigenspace: top eigenvectors of Cpt Ctp v = lambda (Cpp + 1e-6 trace(Cpp)/9 I) v; normalized in Cpp metric; deterministic sign canonicalization

identifier.features: constant + 5 predictive patch projections per channel + seven degree-2/3 center monomials

frozen_pass_rule: PASS only if all 45 registered split-replicate cells have companded rollout MSE / persistence MSE < 1.0. Any single cell >=1 makes Phase 19 FAIL. No retries or replacement of consumed seeds.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law benchmark only. Even a pass would not establish unrestricted operator discovery or novel physics.
